statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (H : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)) [Fintype H] (χ : (Fin n → ZMod p) → ℂ) (b : Fin n → ZMod p), (∀ x y, χ (x+y)=χ x*χ y) → (∃ h : H, χ h.val ≠ 1) → (∑ h : H, χ (b+h.val)) = 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0034 · 用平移证明非平凡字符的陪集和为零
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0034 · Cancel the sum of a nontrivial character over a coset

brief.zh: 沿已检出的方向平移陪集；求和不变，非平凡相位迫使总和为零。
brief.en: Translate the coset by a detected direction. The sum is unchanged and is multiplied by a nontrivial phase.
